name: Zap Blastum
description:
About This Game

You may not look like a hero, but that just means the robots won't see you coming!

Zap has always dreamed of saving the galaxy. When robots invade, it's finally time to jump into action! This is a fast-paced top-down cover shooter where smart positioning is your advantage. Snap into cover, lock onto enemies, collect upgrades, and outsmart robot armies across five colorful worlds. The odds are against you, but anyone can be a hero!

A TOP-DOWN SHOOTER BUILT AROUND COVER

In Zap Blastum, cover is your greatest weapon.

  • Snap into cover at any wall

  • Automatically lean around corners while firing

  • Dash between safe positions under heavy fire

  • Outsmart enemies using positioning and timing

       

FOCUS ON STRATEGY, NOT AIM

Select a target to lock onto, hold fire, and Zap takes care of aiming so you can focus on movement and tactical positioning. Robot enemies use cover too, can coordinate flanking maneuvers, and always take the shot. Staying one step ahead is the key to survival.

       

UPGRADE YOUR STRATEGY

Earn upgrades throughout your adventure and create powerful combinations of status effects, damage, shield, and stamina increases, chain reactions, and more. No two playthroughs have to be the same. 

WARM, COLORFUL, EXPLODE-Y

Zap Blastum delivers exciting combat in a lighthearted world, without dark and gritty realism. Explore five bright, colorful worlds, hand-drawn animated cutscenes, and a fun original soundtrack mixing orchestral, rock, and dubstep.

OUT OF THIS WORLD FEATURES

  • Explore 30 handcrafted levels that span across 5 planets.

  • Lots of different types of cover to keep things fresh: short, tall, destructible, status effects, and more

  • Fight 10+ types of robot enemies.

  • Hijack vehicles like turrets, mechs, speeders, and copters

  • 30 upgrades with 4 levels each

  • Hand-drawn animated cutscenes 

  • Epic original soundtrack

  • Full controller support
